title: 2026 Singapore Hot Wheels Convention
summary: The 2026 Singapore Hot Wheels Convention (officially the 1st Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention Singapore 2026) took place from 25 to 27 September 2026 in Singapore. Andrés Andrieu was the guest of honor at the event. As with all previous editions, this event was organized by Korei.

title: 40th Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention

summary: The following vehicles could only be found in Multi-Packs (3, 8, 10, and 20 Packs) in the year 2026. Toy # goes as the following: 3-packs: K5904, 8-packs: HPV78, 9/10-packs: X6999 & 20-packs: H7045. Some multi-pack exclusive vehicles use existing tampo designs but were released with different colors and wheels, these vehicles are mixed into the contents of the multi-pack.
